title: Using Mesenchymal Stem Cells to Fill Bone Void Defects in Patients With Benign Bone Lesions
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether using mesenchymal stem cells will heal benign bone lesion defects faster than demineralized bone matrix
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ages \> 11 years
* Benign bone lesion

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous surgery
